evidence.claim: Bharat Flameproof self-reports maintaining an "extensive distribution network" supporting a diverse client base from its core manufacturing facility located in the MIDC Industrial Estate in Dombivli East, Thane, Maharashtra, as documented on Justdial.
The company operates primarily as a regional supplier, listed alongside other localized electrical vendors within the B2B marketplace index for Flameproof Junction Box Dealers in Mumbai.

Distribution & Channel Network in India.assessed_on: We verified the company's localized operations in Maharashtra and generic self-reported distribution claims. This is not disclosed by the company, so desk research could not confirm independent verification regarding the exact number of retail touchpoints, nationwide geographic coverage, or partnerships with major electrical wholesalers.
